originality.rationale: Inspected primary results do not imply the all-odd-q numerator-two b=5/2 frame family with explicit bounds. The most relevant 2026 paper explicitly leaves p>1 converse open; the 2018 theorem's regional a and b restrictions exclude the entire specified family. An accessible earlier p=2,q=5 result excludes b=5/2 itself, and two other close published-finding corpus records concern p=1 or a different b. Unindexed covering conditions remain a real residual risk.
residual_risks: Unindexed equivalent statements or broad sufficient frame regions in other older papers may cover some parameters without naming q; no exhaustiveness claim.

The q5 previously established open interval approaches the new endpoint, but an open interval does not imply the endpoint. Numerical fibers alone cannot prove the global result; the stated symbolic identities and analytic bounds do.
